Service worker registration confirmed on page load.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 PWA Push Notifications feature fully tested. All backend push endpoints working for both employee portal and admin notification preferences. Service worker is registered and contains push event handlers. Push notification subscription requires browser permission which cannot be granted in automated tests, so backend API testing is more reliable. The admin notifications page shows 7 category cards with per-event toggles for IN-APP, EMAIL, PUSH channels.
